metadata.mechanism: Quiescence/progress null and negative controls, not an L1 separation witness.
metadata.queue: Finite queue state is carried by worker 1 and preserved by its idle-only transfer; no extra component transfer is introduced.
metadata.versions: Old and new use the same scheduling abstraction; only version tags and the fixed transfer domain distinguish them.
metadata.update_point: Every worker transfers only while idle. All-group requires all workers idle simultaneously.
metadata.endpoint_scope: Every reachable old endpoint state is an initial snapshot; every reachable new endpoint state is loadable.
metadata.arrival_semantics: No arrival is enabled at capacity.
metadata.source_scope: Kitsune motivates per-thread update points and quiescence. Queue, dispatch, and arrival regimes are this explicit finite abstraction, not a reproduction of Kitsune.
